function_name.ui:help: A unique name for your Azure Function

function_app_name.ui:help: The host Function App name that will contain this function

region.ui:help: Select the Azure region closest to your users

runtime_version.ui:help: Specify the runtime version (e.g., 3.9 for Python, 16.x for Node.js)

plan_type.ui:help: Consumption: Pay-per-execution (default); Premium: Always-on with guaranteed capacity; Dedicated: App Service Plan

sku_tier.ui:help: Select the SKU tier for Premium or Dedicated plans

trigger_type.ui:help: The event that triggers function execution (HTTP, Timer, Blob Storage, Queue, etc.)

file_upload.ui:help: Upload the function code as a ZIP package

github_branch.ui:help: Connect to a GitHub repository for continuous deployment

memory_mb.ui:help: Memory allocation (Premium/Dedicated plans only). Consumption plan has fixed memory.

timeout_seconds.ui:help: Maximum execution time before the function times out

storage_account.ui:help: Azure Storage account for function state, bindings, and logs

vnet_integration.ui:help: Enable VNet integration for secure network access (Premium/Dedicated only)

environment.ui:help: Add environment variables for your function

tags.ui:help: Add tags for cost tracking and resource organization
